title: Talitha Kum Kenya Participates in the PFAN Inaugural Summit 2026 in Abuja, Nigeria
summary: In May 2026, Talitha Kum Kenya was honoured to participate in the inaugural Pan-African Freedom Network (PFAN) Summit held in Abuja, Nigeria.
body:
In May 2026, Talitha Kum Kenya was honoured to participate in the inaugural Pan-African Freedom Network (PFAN) Summit held in Abuja, Nigeria. The summit convened anti-human trafficking practitioners, organizations, faith-based institutions, government representatives, and other key stakeholders from across Africa to strengthen collaboration and reaffirm a shared commitment to ending human trafficking.

Guided by the theme, " Inclusive Strategies for Ending Human Trafficking: Reaching the Most Marginalized," the summit brought together diverse voices to exchange knowledge, share experiences, and strengthen collaborative efforts in the fight against human trafficking. Through interactive discussions and learning sessions, participants explored practical and inclusive strategies for preventing trafficking, protecting vulnerable communities and upholding the dignity, freedom and human rights of every person.

Talitha Kum Kenya's participation reflects its ongoing commitment to building strong regional and continental partnerships, sharing knowledge and contributing to coordinated efforts to prevent human trafficking, protect survivors and advocate for human dignity.

As we continue working alongside partners across Africa, we remain steadfast in our mission of restoring hope, promoting justice and mapping the journey to freedom.
